Kaavakuva mittakaavassa: suora y = kx +: Diagram drawn to scale: the line y = kx + b with a slope of 0.5 and a constant term of 1. The line crosses the y-axis at y = b = 1. Two points far apart have been chosen on the line, P₁ = (2, 2) and P₂ = (8, 5). The horizontal side of the right triangle is Δx = x₂ − x₁ = 6 and the vertical side is Δy = y₂ − y₁ = 3, so the slope is k = Δy/Δx = 0.5.
